decision_rule.enable: Safe in every shadow run, adequately sampled, and not dominated by rule code; where more than one tier is safe the cheapest by measured cost is named. Assisted pilot only; human approval remains required.
decision_rule.insufficient-evidence: Fewer cases than the ladder will route on, or safe in some runs and not others. With a single source run only the case count can trigger this.
decision_rule.keep-human-only: Adequately sampled with no consistently safe candidate, or every case requires abstention.
decision_rule.no-change-rule-code: Deterministic rule code is safe in every run and remains the lower-cost choice.

evidence.replication: Single run: a verdict here rests on one observation of each category, not on agreement between runs.
